title: Journey
description: A job the system does for someone, told as what they do and see from start to finish: the product-level story the flows implement (create a session and reattach to it from elsewhere; get an explainer of a repository).

summary.description: The job in the user's words: "Get an explainer of a repository".

actor.description: Who the job is for: a person, or a program using the system as a client.

need.description: Why they come to the system: what they cannot do, or not easily, without it.

value.description: What they have at the end that they did not before.

items.description: One moment of the journey, from the actor's side.

action.description: What the actor does: "Runs /feynman-explain in Pi".

sees.description: What they see or get back.

flows.description: Flows this stage sets off, in order.

entry.description: Where the stage enters the code: the command, route, or handler the actor reaches.
